newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNYARDS SAYS HOLLMING SELLS STAKE TO OPTIOMI.
newsitem.headline: FINNYARDS SAYS HOLLMING SELLS STAKE TO OPTIOMI.

text.p: Finnish shipyard Finnyards Oy said on Friday that Hollming Oy had sold its 39.1 percent stake in it to Finnish investment company Optiomi Oy for an undisclosed sum.
"Finnyards Oy's business operation as a builder of high quality steel-structured vessels and aluminium-structured fast ferries will remain unchanged," it said.
After the sale, Finnyards owners are forest industry group UPM-Kymmene with a 47.9 percent stake, Optiomi with its 39.1 percent and the Finnish state with 13.0 percent, Finnyards said.
Finnyards managing director Kari Airaksinen declined to comment on the price of the deal and said he did not know who owned Optiomi.
